The job failed during setup because **a nested action wasn’t pinned to a full commit SHA**.

The raw log reports:
> The action actions/attest-build-provenance@v2 is not allowed in jdx/hk because all actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA.

Although `jdx/packslip` itself is SHA-pinned, its [composite action](https://github.com/jdx/packslip/blob/a6eddff2d884891faa2efbec374b48e7053df2c4/action.yml) uses `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` internally. The policy applies to that dependency too.

Fix: pin that dependency in **jdx/packslip**, then update hk to the corrected packslip commit. Rerunning the unchanged job won’t resolve it.
